#### A Transformer against a GRU

Train `transformer` and `gru_lm` with `train_lm()` for 1,500 steps each,
at [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) 0.005.
Which has the lower [perplexity](language-models.qmd#def-perplexity) on the validation text?
